summary: Full test of Velora Admin Products feature. Backend: 32/32 pytest passing (17 legacy + 15 new for /api/products + /api/admin/products CRUD & auth). Frontend: verified admin login, tab switching, product list rendering (117 rows), price edit + save + persist across reload, stock toggle, add-product dialog, edit dialog prefill + save, delete flow, price/stock reflection on public catalog + PDP, out-of-stock overlay/badge + Sold-out disabled button on ProductCard, PDP Sold-Out state, PDP single product-main-image on pista-plain-roasted and black-pepper (desktop 1440 & mobile 412 — exactly 1 image in the gallery container, no thumbnails), keyword alias search (badam→Almonds, elaichi→Cardamom). Found 2 real UI bugs and 1 minor code-quality issue (see below). Cleaned up all TEST_ products; reverted price/stock mutations. Catalog back to 117.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL runtime ReferenceError: 'PRODUCTS is not defined' at line 28 — homepage catalog was completely broken (0 testids, blank cream page). PRODUCTS.length is used to display the '{count}+ handpicked products' headline but PRODUCTS was never imported. I applied a minimal fix (added `import { PRODUCTS } from "@/data/products";`) to unblock testing. Consider using dynamic `products.length` from the context instead so the count auto-updates when admin adds/removes products.

After editing a product's price through the Add/Edit dialog (pa-price + pa-save), the toast says 'Product updated' and the DB is updated (verified via API, price=777) but the row's price-input in the table still shows the OLD value (555). Root cause: PriceCell holds its own `useState(product.price)` which initialises once and never re-syncs when the parent replaces the product in state. Fix: add `useEffect(() => setValue(product.price), [product.price])` inside PriceCell, or key it on product.price. Inline-edit + save works fine because the same component owns the change.

issues: On product detail pages, the static-fallback price is briefly shown (~200-400ms) before the DB fetch overrides it. Not a bug per se (fallback is intentional) but if the seeded static price differs from live DB price, users see a flash. Consider showing a loading skeleton or waiting for context to hydrate before rendering price.

action_items: HIGH: Fix PriceCell stale value — add `useEffect(() => setValue(product.price), [product.price])` in /app/frontend/src/components/AdminProducts.jsx (PriceCell component) so the input re-syncs when the parent replaces the product after the dialog save.

HIGH-alt: (already patched by testing agent) Confirm /app/frontend/src/components/ProductCatalog.jsx now imports PRODUCTS. Better long-term fix: use `products.length` from the ProductsContext hook so headline count updates with DB.
LOW: Consider consistent styled AlertDialog instead of window.confirm() for both admin subscriber-delete and product-delete.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — clean, correct auth guard, unique slug generation with retry loop, MongoDB _id excluded from all responses, 404/400/401 codes correct, seed-if-empty only runs when collection is empty (idempotent).

AdminProducts.jsx — PriceCell has stale-state bug (see UI bugs). Also editing the same product via dialog while a dirty price edit is pending in PriceCell would overwrite user input; consider making PriceCell fully controlled from parent.

ProductsContext.jsx — never re-fetches after admin mutations from a different tab. Site is only updated after full page reload. Acceptable, but a `reload()` after admin save on the same tab would improve UX (currently AdminProducts replaces local state only, doesn't tell ProductsContext to reload).
ProductCatalog.jsx — headline uses static PRODUCTS.length instead of dynamic products.length; will not update as admin adds new products until the frontend source is rebuilt.
Frontend — search input testid 'product-search-input' only mounts inside ProductCatalog which is at bottom of home; that's fine, no blocking issue.
All admin endpoints have consistent X-Admin-Token check via _require_admin — reused, DRY.
Backend tests: 32/32 green in 3.2s including auth, CRUD, slug uniqueness, sort order, empty-payload 400, non-existent 404.

rca_of_the_issue: Bug 1 (blank homepage): ProductCatalog.jsx referenced PRODUCTS without importing it, causing a ReferenceError inside render → React unmounts everything below. Fix: added missing import. Bug 2 (stale price after dialog edit): PriceCell derives initial state from product.price only on mount; parent's replaceInList updates the product prop but the child's useState is not reset. Fix: `useEffect(() => setValue(product.price), [product.price])` inside PriceCell. Reproduction: Admin > Products > Edit any product > change price > Save > observe row's price input still shows old value while toast says 'Product updated' and API returns new price. Data is safe; UI stale until reload.
